name: Bryce Canyon National Park
tagline: Rim overlooks of orange hoodoos — skip the full amphitheater hike for little kids.

practical.transit_note: Scenic drive + short walks to overlooks; shuttle in peak season sometimes.
practical.energy_note: High elevation; cold mornings even in summer.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → Sunrise/Sunset Point style overlook → second rim stop
practical.season_note: Snow possible late spring; summer storms afternoon.
